title: Multimedia Production Pipeline Database — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods, framings, and analyses developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout; never mixed with public-harvest records. Scripts, storyboards, asset specifications, rendering workflows, and quality checks. The Multimedia Production Pipeline Database documents how media gets made, end to end: scripts, storyboards, asset specifications (what each image, clip, and sound must be), rendering workflows, and the quality checks at each stage. Amateur productions fail in pre-production — vague scripts, missing assets, no review gates. Each record is a complete production pipeline with the stage gates that keep it on track.

title: Multimedia Production Pipeline Database — Knowledge: technical reference
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods, framings, and analyses developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout; never mixed with public-harvest records. Pipeline stages: PRE-PRODUCTION (concept, script, storyboard, asset list, schedule) -> PRODUCTION (asset creation: illustration, filming, recording; dailies/reviews) -> POST (edit, color, sound mix, graphics) -> RENDER (settings, queue, verification) -> DELIVER (formats per platform, captions, metadata) -> ARCHIVE (project files, assets, versions). Script anatomy: logline, beats, dialogue/action, timing. Storyboard: shot, composition, camera, duration, notes. Asset spec: type, dimensions/duration, format, style guide reference, license status. Render: resolution, framerate, codec, bitrate; verify output (watch it through). Quality gates: defined criteria per stage (script: clear objective + timing; storyboard: shots cover script; final: technical check + content review). Version control for project files.

demo.title: Execution: Bayesian knowledge tracing update
demo.code: let pL=0.3;const pT=0.2,pS=0.1,pG=0.25;function update(correct){const pC=pL*(1-pS)+(1-pL)*pG;const pLgiven=correct?(pL*(1-pS)/pC):(pL*pS/(pL*pS+(1-pL)*(1-pG)));pL=pLgiven+(1-pLgiven)*pT;return pL;}const responses=[1,1,0,1,1];const traj=responses.map(update);const mastered=traj[traj.length-1]>=0.95;J({final:+traj[traj.length-1].toFixed(3),mastered});assert(traj.every(v=>v>=0&&v<=1),'bkt-range');assert(traj[traj.length-1]>0.3,'bkt-learn');

demo.title: Verification: concept graph is a DAG
demo.code: const edges=[['arith','algebra'],['algebra','deriv'],['deriv','backprop']];const nodes=[...new Set(edges.flat())];function topo(){const indeg={};nodes.forEach(n=>indeg[n]=0);edges.forEach(([a,b])=>indeg[b]++);const q=nodes.filter(n=>indeg[n]===0);const order=[];while(q.length){const n=q.shift();order.push(n);edges.filter(e=>e[0]===n).forEach(([a,b])=>{if(--indeg[b]===0)q.push(b);});}return order;}const order=topo();J({order,isDAG:order.length===nodes.length});assert(order.length===nodes.length&&order.indexOf('arith')<order.indexOf('backprop'),'dag');
